articles.title: Mike Novogratz’s Galaxy receives New York BitLicense for institutional crypto push
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital became the second company this year to secure a New York BitLicense, following Strike’s approval in March.

articles.title: Stripe-backed Tempo taps $7.5 billion DeFi lender Morpho to expand beyond payments
articles.snippet: The move brings onchain yield and lending to the payments-focused chain in a bid to offer full-stack onchain finance platform to companies building on it.

articles.title: Bitcoin faces outsized quantum threat as computing breakthroughs accelerate, Citi says
articles.snippet: The bank said accelerating advances in quantum computing are compressing the timeline for risks to crypto and broader internet infrastructure, with Bitcoin seen as particularly exposed.

articles.title: Crypto security is turning into an AI arms race as agents may overwhelm compliance teams
articles.snippet: AI agents and automated payments could reach a scale that crypto monitoring systems built for human-paced markets cannot handle, Elliptic CEO Simone Maini warned.

articles.title: Deploi Launches Direct Issuance Infrastructure for Private Credit on Polygon, Secures ISIN Allocations from Nasdaq CSD
articles.snippet: EUR 1 billion note programme planned for 2026 following completion of global issuance infrastructure by the end of Q3 2026.
